properties.name: easygram.token
properties.description: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. Required for all transports.

properties.name: easygram.update.transport
properties.description: Update-delivery transport. LONG_POLLING (default) polls Telegram getUpdates API; WEBHOOK receives updates via HTTPS endpoint. Ignored when easygram.messaging.type=CONSUMER.

values.description: Poll Telegram getUpdates API (default). No public URL required.
Receive updates via an HTTPS webhook endpoint. Requires easygram.update.webhook.url.
